thread:
Maya: quick PSA — Horizon-v1 (ptq/int8) canary is showing a sharp uptick in structured-output parse failures for funcalls. summary: sample=2000, parse_fail=160 (8.0%) vs fp16 mirror 6 failures (0.3%). saving a few traces to the ticket.

Kiran: ugh. any obvious clusters?

Maya: two reproducible patterns: (1) arguments emitted as a JSON string (double-escaped) i.e. \"arguments\": \"{\\\"user\\\":42}\" instead of an object; (2) truncated suffixes where final braces are missing when KV prefix grows (seen in streamed responses). also rare trailing commas and raw newlines inside fields.

Sam: examples pasted: 
```\nREQ: {\"prompt\":\"call fetch_orders(user=42)\",\"function_call\":{\"name\":\"fetch_orders\"}}\nRESP (stream): ...\"function_call\":{\"name\":\"fetch_orders\",\"arguments\":\"{\\\"user\\\":42,\\\"limit\\\":10}\"}...\n```\ntruncation example:
```\n...\"function_call\":{\"name\":\"fetch_orders\",\"arguments\":{\"user\":42,\"items\":[\"a\",\"b\"]\n```\n(no closing braces).

Maya: canary config used temp=0.55 for diversity. int8 avg toolcall token_len +10% vs fp16, so more tokens -> more chances to hit cutoffs.

Kiran: mitigation proposal: (A) ship a canary-only \"rescue\" parser that: if value is a string try JSON.parse(inner); try simple repairs (strip trailing commas, replace unescaped newlines with \n escapes); tolerate empty NDJSON lines. always attach original_text and a rescue_applied flag to telemetry. (B) small goldens stressing nested arrays/long args added to canary. (C) single mirrored fp16 retry when rescue fails, instead of multi-retry. block rollout if post-rescue fail >1%.

Sam: +1. also add harness fuzzer that injects double-escaped variants and NDJSON blank-line cases. I'll sketch and run.

perf-bot: perf-bot: queued micro-bench job Horizon-v1 int8 vs fp16 structured-output 1000 prompts (measuring parse_fail, token_count, cutoff_count, avg latency).

Maya: implementation notes: keep repairs cheap and explainable. telemetry fields: original_text, rescue_steps (list), rescued=true/false, parse_error_code. record token_delta when rescue applied. do not silently mutate fields: tag fields that were repaired.

Kiran: quick triage Q: tokenizer misalignment (off-by-one) vs PTQ kernel padding? logs often end on a non-brace token -> points to truncation at stream boundary. we should also check recent compiler/kernel tiling changes.

Infra: qa-bot: created ticket INF-2026-113 \"Horizon-v1 int8 funcall parse regression\" (assign: eng-ml + infra). pinned canary and blocked wider rollout.

Sam: timeline: I'll land fuzzer + harness tonight, run the 1k micro-bench, and push results to canary dashboard. If rescue reduces parse_fail <1% we can keep canary with rescue; otherwise pin to fp16.

Maya: I'll open PR for rescue parser in lib/parse/rescue with unit tests and telemetry hooks; assigning @Kiran and @Sam for review. include tests for: double-escaped JSON, trailing commas, NDJSON blank lines, truncated-suffix heuristics.

Kiran: remember retry budget constraints — cheap in-place repairs first, then exactly one mirrored fp16 retry. include a counter so we don't exceed retry budget.

Sam: noted. bench will also report token and cost impact of rescue vs fp16 retry.

Maya: thanks — tagging for follow-up. will update ticket with PR link and bench output. :eyes:
